name: Benji Knoll
source:
Benji Knoll is a Belvoire University student and the resident advisor of the Winfrey dorm complex. He makes his first appearance in Book 1, Chapter 2.

Unlike most students at Belvoire, Benji attends the university on a scholarship. In exchange for not having to pay tuition, Benji is required to work as an RA. This also means he must live in a dorm room that is quainter in comparison to the wealthier students' luxury suites. While he is visibly unhappy about this arrangement, Your Character's arrival on campus and subsequent challenging of the highest-ranked students has inspired him to improve himself. 

[spoiler]Unfortunately, his admiration rapidly morphs into obsession, to the point where he not only stalks Your Character, but builds a shrine to her consisting of food and various items he has stolen from her room. The rotting food making up the "Admiration Station," as he calls it, has taken on such a bad stench that he has begun wearing Your Character's stolen perfume to cover up the smell.[/spoiler]
